items.t: Timing chain stretch
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners (3.6L V6)
items.note: Shops often add the water pump while the engine is open. Cost rises a lot if the chain already skipped and damaged valves.

items.t: Lost 3rd, 5th and reverse gears
items.job: Rebuild transmission with updated 3-5-reverse wave plate
items.note: A remanufactured transmission costs more but carries a better warranty. AWD models take longer.

items.t: Service Air Bag warning from seat wiring (recall)
items.job: Repair front seat airbag wiring harness connector
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Liftgate struts wear and gate drops (recall)
items.job: Replace both liftgate gas struts
items.note: Recall repair is free for affected years. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Rear A/C evaporator leaks
items.job: Replace rear A/C evaporator and expansion valve, recharge
items.note: Includes evacuating and recharging the A/C system. Ask about bulletin 16-NA-046.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator may rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag module
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer right away.

items.t: Shift to Park message when already in Park
items.job: Replace shifter assembly or Park position switch
items.note: Some shops fix only the Park switch inside the shifter, which costs less. Ask about bulletin 19-NA-206.

items.t: Stop/start accumulator bolts missing or loose (recall)
items.job: Install accumulator cover bolts and refill transmission fluid
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN. Cost rises a lot if the transmission was damaged by low fluid.

items.t: 9-speed automatic shudder and rough shifts
items.job: Transmission fluid exchange and relearn per GM bulletin
items.note: If the torque converter or transmission must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Transmission will not upshift or sticks in 2nd
items.job: Replace transmission control solenoid valve body
items.note: Sometimes fixed with a software update or connector repair, which costs far less. Ask about bulletin PIP5557.

items.t: Front half-shaft can slip out (recalls)
items.job: Inspect and replace front half-shaft (axle)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Radiator hose quick-connect coolant leaks
items.job: Replace radiator hose and quick-connect fittings, refill coolant
items.note: Covered by GM special coverage for affected SUVs. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Stalls after remote start or in cold weather
items.job: Engine control software update
items.note: Usually done free under the factory warranty on these newer SUVs. Ask about bulletin PIP6102.

items.t: Ticking from the top of the engine
items.job: Replace faulty lash adjusters and rocker arms (2.5L turbo)
items.note: Usually covered by the powertrain warranty on these newer SUVs. Ask about bulletin PIP6101.

items.t: Front seat recliner brackets poorly welded (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat recliner or seatback frame
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may not be attached properly (recall)
items.job: Inspect and realign or replace curtain airbag weld nuts
items.note: Free under recall 21V246. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor can overheat and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper motor cover or motor
items.note: Free under recall 15V609. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Third-row seat frame welds may be in the wrong place (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace third-row seat frame
items.note: Free under recall 15V833. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Plastic burr in the fuel pump can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump module
items.note: Free under recall 20V639. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine compartment frame rail may crack (recall)
items.job: Inspect engine compartment frame rail
items.note: Free under recall 19V643. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Roof-rail airbag connector may have the wrong terminals (recall)
items.job: Replace roof-rail airbag harness connector
items.note: Free under recall 22V210. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Airbag software calibration may be wrong (recall)
items.job: Reprogram the airbag control module
items.note: Free under recall 21V472. Check the VIN first.
